run_jeopardy_preprocessing: run the Jeopardy dataset preprocessing script to generate k-shot data for multiple random seeds
create_jeopardy_dataset_instance: create a Jeopardy dataset instance that loads the HuggingFace jeopardy dataset for few-shot learning
build_train_test_split: build an 80/20 train/test split from the jeopardy dataset using numpy random shuffle with seed 42
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a HuggingFace jeopardy dataset split to a list of question category and answer tuples
generate_k_shot_data: generate k-shot few-shot learning data from the Jeopardy dataset with configurable seed and output path
